title: Merge feature/f14-contact-email: publish hello@jordimp.net from a single CONTACT_EMAIL literal

req_statements.R1: The system shall not emit the string `gmail.com` in any source file under `src/`, any test file under `tests/`, or any built HTML file under `dist/`.  Verification: the unit test `src/config.spec.ts` pins the value; the `qa:content` gate scans both the `src/` + `tests/` sources and the visible text of every `dist/**/*.html` for `gmail.com`; the manual command `rg -n "gmail" src dist` returns no match.
req_statements.R2: WHEN any page renders an email pill (the `FooterDesk` footer pill, or the front-desk `DeptPanel` pill on the home building page), the system shall set that pill's `href` to `mailto:hello@jordimp.net`, while the pill's visible label stays the localized `FOOTER.email` string in the page locale.  Verification: `tests/home.spec.ts` asserts, on each of `/en/`, `/es/`, `/ca/`, that `.footer-desk .pill[href^="mailto:"]` has `href="mailto:hello@jordimp.net"`.
req_statements.R3: WHEN the front desk department page (`/{lang}/departments/front-desk/`) renders in any of the three locales, the system shall display `hello@jordimp.net` as the email contact-row value, and set the row's copy button `data-copy` to `hello@jordimp.net`.  Verification: `tests/departments.spec.ts` asserts, for all three locales, that the first `.contact-row .contact-row__v` has text `hello@jordimp.net` and that `button.copy-btn[data-copy]` equals `hello@jordimp.net` (the existing assertions already use `SITE.email`, which must resolve to the same value).
req_statements.R4: WHEN a page emits the `Person` JSON-LD block, the system shall set its `email` property to `mailto:hello@jordimp.net`.  Verification: `src/lib/seo.spec.ts` pins `personJsonLd('en').email` to the literal.
req_statements.R5: WHEN the site builds the `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` endpoints, the system shall emit `hello@jordimp.net` in the `llms.txt` contact block (`- Email:`) and in the `llms-full.txt` contact line (`Contact:`).  Verification: `src/lib/llms.spec.ts` and `src/lib/llms-endpoint.spec.ts` pin the literal in both builders; the committed oracle `src/lib/__snapshots__/llms-endpoint.spec.ts.snap` is refreshed with `vitest -u` and reviewed for the address-only change.
req_statements.R6: WHILE the `hello@jordimp.net` mailbox is not verified deliverable — MX and SPF records present for `jordimp.net` and a forwarded test message received in the owner's inbox, with the evidence recorded in `harness/progress/impl_contact-email.md` — the system shall not emit `hello@jordimp.net` in `src/` or `dist/` (the contact-email feature stays `blocked`).  Verification: Task 0 of `tasks.md` records the evidence (the `dig` output for MX/SPF and a confirmation that the test message reached the inbox). If the evidence is absent, the `rg -n "hello@jordimp.net" src dist` check must be empty and no implementation task runs; the leader keeps the feature in `blocked`.
req_statements.R7: The system shall define the canonical address exactly once as a `CONTACT_EMAIL` literal in `src/config.ts`, and have both `src/config.ts` `SITE.email` and `src/data/content.ts` `SITE.email` reference it.  Verification: `src/config.spec.ts` asserts `CONTACT_EMAIL === 'hello@jordimp.net'`, `CONFIG_SITE.email === CONTACT_EMAIL` and `CONTENT_SITE.email === CONTACT_EMAIL`.
req_statements.R8: The receiving path for `hello@jordimp.net` shall be provisioned on a provider's free tier (no paid mail plan required) — either free custom-domain forwarding (e.g. ImprovMX, forwardemail.net, Cloudflare Email Routing) or a free real mailbox (e.g. Zoho Mail Free, DNSExit) — with the chosen provider and tier recorded in the Task 0 evidence.  Verification: `harness/progress/impl_contact-email.md` names the provider and states the free tier used (forwarding rule or mailbox plan); no billing/payment method is required. This is a human-evidence requirement, checked at the completion gate alongside R6.

T1.title: Single source of truth + unit tests + snapshot

T2.title: E2E — footer and front-desk surfaces in all three locales

T3.title: Negative assertion — no `gmail.com` in sources or built HTML

T4.title: Regenerate the parity fixture and diff-review it
